apparatus: Insertion <πονηρὸν>. || papyrus page 49. Continues Witte p.148 / PDF 152.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: God was in Christ reconciling a world to himself.
LXX: as an innocent lamb led to be sacrificed, I did not know.
The Son of man must suffer many things and be killed and rise on the third day.

choices.why: Jeremiah 11:19 LXX first-person, applied to Christ as the lamb.

pass_a_gloss: And these things were being completed in Christ as he says: For God was in Christ reconciling a world to himself, and the reconciliation was happening in the as an innocent lamb being led to be sacrificed he did not know. For they reckoned against him a wicked reckoning, having known that the Son of man must suffer many things and be killed and on the third day rise.
pass_b_english: And these things were being completed in Christ, as he says: "For God was in Christ reconciling a world to himself," and the reconciliation was taking place in the "as an innocent lamb being led to be sacrificed he did not know." For they reckoned a wicked reckoning against him, having known that "the Son of man must suffer many things and be killed and on the third day rise."
source_text: Ταῦτα δὲ ἐν Χ(ριστ)ῷ ἐτελεῖτο ὡς λέγει· "Ὁ θ(εὸ)ς γὰρ ἦν ἐν Χ(ριστ)ῷ κόσμον καταλλάσσων ἑαυτῷ", ἡ δὲ καταλλαγὴ ἐγίνετο ἐν τῷ "ὡς ἀρνίον ἄκακον ἀγόμενον τοῦ θύεσθαι οὐκ ἔγνω". ἐλογίσαντο γὰρ ἐπ’ αὐτὸν λογισμὸν <πονηρὸν> γνόντες τὸ "δεῖ τὸν υ(ἱὸ)ν τοῦ ἀν(θρώπ)ου πολλὰ παθεῖν καὶ ἀποκτανθῆναι καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἀ||ναστῆναι".
